rungs.title: Project Coordinator
rungs.summary: Learning how projects are planned, tracked and reported.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the plan, the tools and the vocabulary of projects.
rungs.delivery: Keeps plans, risks and actions up to date for a project manager.
rungs.leadership: Writes clear notes and chases actions politely and persistently.

rungs.title: Project Manager
rungs.summary: Delivers a project to scope, time and budget.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in planning, requirements, risk and the delivery lifecycle.
rungs.delivery: Delivers a project to scope, time and budget and reports honestly.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team without authority and keeps stakeholders aligned.

rungs.title: Senior Project Manager
rungs.summary: Delivers the large, risky or cross-team projects.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in estimation, dependencies and budgets; understands the technical work.
rungs.delivery: Delivers large projects and recovers troubled ones.
rungs.leadership: Negotiates with senior stakeholders and mentors project managers.

rungs.title: Programme Manager
rungs.summary: Runs a programme of related projects toward a business outcome.
rungs.knowledge: Connects projects to strategy, budget and benefits.
rungs.delivery: Owns a programme's outcome, budget and dependencies.
rungs.leadership: Leads project managers and reports to senior leadership.

rungs.title: Head of Project Delivery
rungs.summary: Owns how the company runs projects.
rungs.knowledge: Sets methods, tools and portfolio governance for the company.
rungs.delivery: Owns the portfolio, delivery standards and capacity plan.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and advises executives on what the company can deliver.
